crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to Moses, “When you go back into Egypt, see that you do before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have put in…
Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.
Yahweh said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn. He refuses to let the people go.
But Yahweh hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go.
But Yahweh hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he wouldn’t let them go.
But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him; for Yahweh your God hardened his spirit and made his heart…
Why then do you harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts? When he had worked wonderfully…
God who is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you…
But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath…
What if God, willing to show his wrath and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath…

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh, but Yahweh hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go out of his land.
translations.bsb: Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh, but the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart so that he would not let the Israelites go out of his land.
translations.kjv: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh: and the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go out of his land.
translations.asv: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh: and Jehovah hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he did not let the children of Israel go out of his land.
